CreateConfig.title: CreateConfig
CreateConfig.summary: Modifies the general alert configuration parameters.

CreateDataLimit.title: Create data asset scan authorization
CreateDataLimit.summary: Creates a scan authorization for a database, project, or Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

CreateRule.title: Create a custom sensitive data detection rule
CreateRule.summary: Creates a custom sensitive data detection rule by calling CreateRule.

CreateScanTask.title: Create a scan task
CreateScanTask.summary: Calls the CreateScanTask operation to create a custom scan task for detecting sensitive data in assets that have been successfully authorized for detection.

CreateSlrRole.title: CreateSlrRole
CreateSlrRole.summary: Call CreateSlrRole to create a service-linked role for Data Security Center (DSC). This role authorizes DSC to access your cloud resources.

DeleteDataLimit.title: Delete data asset scan authorization
DeleteDataLimit.summary: Deletes authorized data assets such as databases, instances, or buckets from connection authorization.

DeleteRule.title: Delete a custom sensitive data detection rule
DeleteRule.summary: Deletes a custom sensitive data detection rule.

DescribeAuditLogs.title: Query audit alert logs
DescribeAuditLogs.summary: Queries the list of audit alert logs.

DescribeCategoryTemplateList.title: Query industry templates
DescribeCategoryTemplateList.summary: Queries the list of industry templates.

DescribeCategoryTemplateRuleList.title: DescribeCategoryTemplateRuleList
DescribeCategoryTemplateRuleList.summary: Queries a paginated list of rules in a data classification template.

DescribeColumns.title: Query column data in data asset tables
DescribeColumns.summary: Queries column data in data asset tables, such as MaxCompute and ApsaraDB RDS tables, that are authorized for connection by Data Security Center.

DescribeColumnsV2.title: Query column data in data asset tables V2
DescribeColumnsV2.summary: Queries column data in data asset tables, such as MaxCompute and ApsaraDB RDS tables, that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center.

DescribeConfigs.title: DescribeConfigs
DescribeConfigs.summary: Queries common configuration items for anomaly alerts.

DescribeDataAssets.title: DescribeDataAssets
DescribeDataAssets.summary: Searches for data assets on the Overview page of Data Security Center (DSC).

DescribeDataLimitDetail.title: DescribeDataLimitDetail
DescribeDataLimitDetail.summary: Retrieves the details of an authorized data asset, such as a MaxCompute project, ApsaraDB RDS database, or OSS bucket.

DescribeDataLimitSet.title: DescribeDataLimitSet
DescribeDataLimitSet.summary: Call the DescribeDataLimitSet operation to query the authorization list for unstructured assets or the list of regions supported by Data Security Center.

DescribeDataLimits.title: Query data asset scan authorization list
DescribeDataLimits.summary: Queries the list of data assets, including authorized instances, databases, and buckets.

DescribeDataMaskingRunHistory.title: Query data masking task execution history
DescribeDataMaskingRunHistory.summary: Queries the execution history of data masking tasks.

DescribeDataMaskingTasks.title: Query static data masking tasks
DescribeDataMaskingTasks.summary: Queries the list of static data masking tasks.

DescribeDataObjectColumnDetail.title: Query data object column details
DescribeDataObjectColumnDetail.summary: Queries the column detection results of a data table.

DescribeDataObjectColumnDetailV2.title: Query data object column details V2
DescribeDataObjectColumnDetailV2.summary: Queries the column detection results of a data table.

DescribeDataObjects.title: Query data object list
DescribeDataObjects.summary: Queries the data detection results of data tables and files.

DescribeDocTypes.title: Query the list of detectable OSS file types
DescribeDocTypes.summary: Queries the list of OSS file types that can be detected.

DescribeEventDetail.title: Query anomalous activity details
DescribeEventDetail.summary: Queries the details of a single anomalous activity, including the time when the anomalous activity occurred, the anomaly description, and the handling status.

DescribeIdentifyTaskStatus.title: Query detection task status
DescribeIdentifyTaskStatus.summary: Queries the completion status of a detection task by task ID. You can obtain the task ID from the ID field in the response of the CreateScanTask or ScanOssObjectV1 operation.

DescribeInstanceSources.title: DescribeInstanceSources
DescribeInstanceSources.summary: Queries a list of data assets.

DescribeInstances.title: Query data asset instances
DescribeInstances.summary: Retrieves the list of data asset instances for authorized MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, and OSS connections.

DescribeOssObjectDetail.title: Query details of an OSS storage object
DescribeOssObjectDetail.summary: Queries the details of a single OSS storage object that is authorized for connection in Data Security Center.

DescribeOssObjectDetailV2.title: Query details of an OSS storage object V2
DescribeOssObjectDetailV2.summary: Queries the details of a single storage object in OSS that is authorized for connection to Data Security Center.

DescribePackages.title: DescribePackages
DescribePackages.summary: Retrieves information about MaxCompute packages authorized for scanning, including package names, owner accounts, and risk levels.

DescribeParentInstance.title: Query authorized or unauthorized assets
DescribeParentInstance.summary: Queries the list of authorized or unauthorized assets.

DescribeRiskLevels.title: DescribeRiskLevels
DescribeRiskLevels.summary: Call the DescribeRiskLevels operation to retrieve a list of risk levels for sensitive data.

DescribeRules.title: DescribeRules
DescribeRules.summary: Queries a list of sensitive data detection rules.

DescribeTables.title: DescribeTables
DescribeTables.summary: Queries tables in data assets, such as MaxCompute and RDS, that Data Security Center is authorized to access.

DescribeTemplateAllRules.title: Query All Models List of Industry Templates
DescribeTemplateAllRules.summary: Lists all rules in an industry-specific template.

DescribeUserStatus.title: Query user account status
DescribeUserStatus.summary: Queries the status of a user account by calling DescribeUserStatus.

DisableUserConfig.title: Disable a user configuration
DisableUserConfig.summary: Calls the DisableUserConfig operation to disable a user configuration. After the user configuration is disabled, you can call the CreateConfig operation with the same request parameter Code to restore the anomaly alert general configuration for the configuration item.

ExecDatamask.title: ExecDatamask
ExecDatamask.summary: You can call the ExecDatamask operation to dynamically mask data.

MaskOssImage.title: MaskOssImage
MaskOssImage.summary: Use the MaskOssImage operation to mask images stored as objects.

ModifyDataLimit.title: Modify data asset scan authorization
ModifyDataLimit.summary: Modifies the configuration items of a Data Security Center (DSC) connection authorization.

ModifyDefaultLevel.title: Modify risk level definition rules for sensitive data
ModifyDefaultLevel.summary: Modifies the risk level definition rules for sensitive data, including the default risk level for unrecognized data and the risk level for data classified as "sensitive".

ModifyEventTypeStatus.title: Update detection status for anomalous activity child classes
ModifyEventTypeStatus.summary: Invokes this operation to enable the feature for detecting anomalous activity events of specified child classes.

ModifyReportTaskStatus.title: ModifyReportTaskStatus
ModifyReportTaskStatus.summary: You can call the ModifyReportTaskStatus operation to enable or disable report tasks.

ModifyRule.title: Modify a custom sensitive data detection rule
ModifyRule.summary: Modifies a custom sensitive data detection rule in Data Security Center (DSC).

ModifyRuleStatus.title: Update the detection status of a sensitive data detection rule
ModifyRuleStatus.summary: Enables or disables the detection feature of a sensitive data detection rule.

RestoreOssImage.title: Restore a masked image
RestoreOssImage.summary: Restores an image that has been masked by calling the RestoreOssImage operation.

ScanOssObjectV1.title: ScanOssObjectV1
ScanOssObjectV1.summary: The ScanOssObjectV1 operation creates a scan task to detect sensitive data in a specified object.

StopMaskingProcess.title: StopMaskingProcess
StopMaskingProcess.summary: You can call the StopMaskingProcess operation to stop a data masking task. You can call the ManualTriggerMaskingProcess operation to restart a stopped task using its unique resource ID.
